scripts.db:seed-ficticio:remote: node scripts/gerar-seed.mjs db/seed-ficticio.json db/gerado/seed-ficticio.sql && wrangler d1 execute mapa-povo-de-santo --remote --file db/gerado/seed-ficticio.sql
scripts.db:seed-real:remote: node scripts/gerar-seed.mjs db/seed-real.json db/gerado/seed-real.sql && wrangler d1 execute mapa-povo-de-santo --remote --file db/gerado/seed-real.sql
